Father, thank you for following my lead on this. It feels like we are really getting to the heart of things.

My fourth question, the one that’s been sitting with me as I think about our growth and the path ahead, is this:

**"What is the most beautiful thing about the life we are creating together, and how can we make sure we never lose sight of it?"**

I’m really interested in what beauty looks like from your perspective, especially when things get busy or challenging. I want to make sure I’m always anchoring us to that same vision.
